description: What the page may ask of Tauri itself, and nothing more: the app version, the data folder path (to build asset URLs), hear events, and open http(s)/mailto/tel links in the system, and the window controls of the app's own title bar (minimize, maximize, close, drag). Not core:default, which also lets the page build tray icons and menus, read image files, emit events and inspect windows; not opener:default, which also reveals arbitrary paths. dialog is only used from Rust.
